up: Retrieve exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested on human Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 1 (target CHEMBL ID: CHEMBL3650). Filter for exact measurements only (standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', standard_units = 'nM'). Only include rows where a canonical SMILES is available and at least one PubMed ID or DOI is present for the source document. Return exactly these columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce pubmed_id and doi), assay_description, target_organism (from target_dictionary), and standard_value. Do not apply any row limits or ranking.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3650'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
